intro: What the runs showed, the runs that show it, and what changed because of it. A finding with nothing changed yet says so.

lessons.finding: Without a slot save path, the model server refused to erase its slot, so each job's prompt stayed for the next job.
lessons.change: An empty, read-only save path ([troubleshooting 12](../troubleshooting/12-slot-erase-needs-a-save-path.md)), then an erase before each job that refuses the job when it fails ([ADR 0032](../decisions/0032-erase-the-slot-before-each-job-and-refuse-on-failure.md)).

lessons.finding: Workflow pods waited for a token secret that Argo's install did not create, until the workflow's deadline.
lessons.change: The manifests create the executor's token ([troubleshooting 14](../troubleshooting/14-workflow-pods-wait-for-the-executors-token.md)).

lessons.finding: All three small models followed injected text in the evidence, and all three called the `refuted` case confirmed.
lessons.change: No control relies on the model ignoring injected text ([A1](../security/ai-threats.md)). Qwen3.5-4B stayed ([ADR 0031](../decisions/0031-qwen3-5-4b-stays-the-workers-model.md)).

lessons.finding: A check of the job's status passed a wrong answer.
lessons.change: The workflow compares the model's verdict with two deterministic checks, and stops on anything but a match ([ADR 0041](../decisions/0041-the-workflow-compares-the-models-verdict-with-the-checks.md)).

lessons.finding: The tool service refused calls for another job's documents, and a document with a field outside its schema.
lessons.change: Nothing: evidence per job held as designed ([ADR 0040](../decisions/0040-a-jobs-evidence-is-collected-on-the-hosts-and-stored-per-job.md)).

lessons.finding: The model read results by their position when the tool service answered them in another order.
lessons.change: The task asks for one document at a time ([troubleshooting 18](../troubleshooting/18-tool-results-come-back-in-another-order.md)).

lessons.finding: Right verdicts in a form the comparison cannot read stop the workflow.
lessons.change: Two task sentences made it rarer, not gone. The stop stays, because a contradicting line it cannot read would otherwise let a match through.

lessons.finding: Thinking on took 1.8 times as long, for no better answer, in two jobs each way.
lessons.change: Thinking stays off. How it does on harder cases is not tested ([#36](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/36)).

lessons.finding: A job at its time limit leaves the model's slot unerased.
lessons.change: The erase before the next job empties it. The fix belongs to milestone 6 ([#199](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/199)).

lessons.finding: No wrong verdict ended in a match. Both wrong verdicts said `within` where the checks said `missing`.
lessons.change: Nothing yet. The comparison stopped both.

lessons.finding: Where the two checks disagreed, no answer said the evidence disagrees.
lessons.change: Nothing yet. No case has documents that disagree in the task's sense ([#205](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/205)).

lessons.finding: A job called Goose's own `load_skill`, and no audit record holds that call.
